environment.description: EKS 1.28 pod running in default namespace with default securityContext. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with full glibc. Pod spec uses default serviceAccount with no PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurityStandard enforcement. Container runs as root (UID 0). No seccomp profile applied. Memory allocator is standard glibc ptmalloc2 with no hardening flags.

config.aslr: enabled but container shares PID namespace with host
